name: ISMS controls
description: Helps to run an information security management system for ISO/IEC 27001 or BSI IT-Grundschutz in the knowledge graph. It adds the kind control (framework, reference, title, status, justification, owner, evidence, last review) and the relation covers from a control to any entry. You enter the references (e.g. A.5.15 or OPS.1.1.2.A3) and your own titles and texts; the plugin ships no catalogue and no texts of the standards. AI clients get the coverage (controls per framework and status, controls without evidence or without a review in the last 12 months, servers, VMs and services no control covers; isms.coverage) and the Statement of Applicability as Markdown (isms.soa). No settings and no network access; it only reads the project's entries.

mcpTools.name: isms.coverage
mcpTools.description: Controls per framework and status, controls without evidence, controls not reviewed in the last 12 months, and servers, VMs and services that no control covers.

mcpTools.name: isms.soa
mcpTools.description: Statement of Applicability as Markdown: every control with reference, title, applicability, status, justification, owner, evidence, last review and the entries it covers.
